name: aloha-abacus
description: Interactive abacus simulator for learning arithmetic calculations

scripts.predeploy: npm run sync-version && npm run generate-changelog
scripts.cap:sync: npm run cap:prepare && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="$(ls -d /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home 2>/dev/null || /usr/libexec/java_home -v 21 2>/dev/null || echo "$JAVA_HOME")" ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk-release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="$(ls -d /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home 2>/dev/null || /usr/libexec/java_home -v 21 2>/dev/null || echo "$JAVA_HOME")" ./gradlew assembleRelease
